title: Bump SDK deps across Python/JS/Go and remove deprecated API shims
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Upgrade critical client SDK dependencies across Python, JavaScript, and Go to remove known CVEs, simplify build matrices, and eliminate legacy API shim layers that were introduced as temporary compatibility adapters. Scope: Python SDK (upgrade httpx 0.24.1 -> 0.26.0, pydantic 1.10.9 -> 2.1.0 with migration shims), JS SDK (axios 1.3.5 -> 1.6.0, typescript 4.8 -> 5.3, migrate off deprecated API surface 'createClientV1' to unified 'createClient'), Go SDK (go 1.20 -> 1.21, google.golang.org/grpc 1.54.0 -> 1.59.0). Also remove the small API shim layer that duplicated response-parsing behavior for older endpoints; replace with a feature-flagged compatibility adapter for one release cycle. Risks: pydantic v2 migration changes model parsing semantics, TypeScript major bump may change emitted types, Go upgrade requires CI container image update. Mitigations: add pydantic v2 compatibility tests, publish a beta SDK release (sdk-2026.03-beta) and a pinned legacy client (createClientLegacy) for customers with strict contracts, run a 2-week canary for Dedicated accounts, and provide a migration guide and codemod scripts. Performance/benefits: updated httpx and connection pooling reduces average API client latency by ~8-12% in internal benchmarks; smaller install size in JS by removing legacy adapter code paths. Rollout plan: 1) branch:eng/ENG-9473/dep-bump; 2) create per-language PRs with changelogs and migration notes; 3) CI: add pydantic-v1/v2 matrix and TypeScript strict mode checks; 4) canary release to 3 internal services + 2 pilot customers; 5) enable compatibility adapter behind feature flag for 4 weeks; 6) remove adapter and cut final release. Testing: unit tests, integration tests against runtime-1.18 staging, end-to-end smoke tests against Hosted API, and load tests for batching/throughput. Rollback: revert SDK package versions and re-enable shim if critical regressions in canary. Follow-ups: post-release migration analytics and create a small project to track customers still using deprecated surface for 90 days.
